def attach_particle(word: str, particle: str) -> str:
    # Hangul syllable block range
    HANGUL_BASE = 0xAC00
    HANGUL_END = 0xD7A3
    # Final consonant list (index 0 means no batchim)
    FINAL_JAMO = [
        "", "ㄱ","ㄲ","ㄴ","ㄷ","ㄸ","ㄹ","ㅁ","ㅂ","ㅃ",
        "ㅅ","ㅆ","ㅇ","ㅈ","ㅉ","ㅊ","ㅋ","ㅌ","ㅍ","ㅎ"
    ]

    last_char = word[-1]
    # Determine if last char is a digit
    if last_char.isdigit():
        # digits are treated as ending with a vowel
        form = particle.split('/')[1]
    elif HANGUL_BASE <= ord(last_char) <= HANGUL_END:
        # Compute final consonant index
        code = ord(last_char) - HANGUL_BASE
        final_index = code % 28
        # Special rule for '으로/로'
        if particle == "으로/로" and final_index == FINAL_JAMO.index("ㄹ"):
            form = particle.split('/')[1]
        else:
            # If there is a final consonant, use the first form
            form = particle.split('/')[0] if final_index != 0 else particle.split('/')[1]
    else:
        # For any other characters, default to vowel form
        form = particle.split('/')[1]

    return word + form
